name: Alpine Ski School
description: Ski & snowboard school template with live canvas snowfall in the hero and a mountain trail that draws itself to map lesson levels.
features: Lift-ticket style 'today on the hill' conditions card in the hero
Interactive level picker that highlights stops on an SVG mountain trail
Six race-bib lesson cards with inclusions and prices
Booking form with lesson selector and preferred date
signature: Canvas snowfall drifts across the hero (paused off-screen); a ski trail draws itself up an SVG mountain, popping in each lesson level
